item_short_desc: Show your American spirit with Rothco’s U.S. Flag, a symbol of national pride and unity. Crafted from durable polyester material, this flag is designed to withstand the elements, ensuring it remains vibrant and intact whether displayed outdoors or indoors. The American flag is available in 2 convenient sizes: 3 feet x 5 feet or 2 feet x 3 feet, making it suitable for various display options, from flag poles to walls. Reinforced with sturdy grommets, this US flag can be easily mounted or hung securely.
